macros.name: academicyear
macros.doc: Use this macro to specify the academic year in full, i.e. in the form XXXX-YYYY.

macros.name: bamadegree
macros.doc: This allows to specify the official degree through an abbreviation.

macros.name: bamadoctype
macros.doc: This allows to set the nature of the thesis.

macros.name: course
macros.doc: Code (first argument) and name (second argument) of the curriculum course this coursematerial or exam belongs to.

macros.name: degree
macros.doc: This is the official degree name (in the appropriate language, possibly mixed “dutch (english)”).

macros.name: engdutmc
macros.doc: typesets a multiple choice answer candidate in two columns, the left column taking the English variant of the question and the right column taking the Dutch variant.

macros.name: examdate
macros.doc: \examdate specifies the date of the exam.

macros.name: examgroupnumber
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@examgroupnumber tag that will be used on the exam title page.

macros.name: examlength
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@examlength tag that will be used on the exam title page.

macros.name: exampart
macros.doc: Description of the part of the course the exam covers.

macros.name: extrainfo
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@extrainfo tag that will be used on the back of the exam title page.

macros.name: extrainfo
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@extrainfo tag that will be used on the back of the exam title page.

macros.name: insertsolutionspage
macros.doc: inserts a full solutions page, i.e. flushes the current page and inserts a full page with ’fill-out’ squares. The argument allows for specifying a watermark text (e.g. ’Scrap paper’).

macros.name: lecturer
macros.doc: You can add one or more lecturers to the course notes (in Dutch: titularis).

macros.name: logo
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@logo tag that will be used to load a graphics file with that name.

macros.name: mc
macros.doc: typesets a multiple choice answer candidate (monolingual, i.e. in a single column).

macros.name: question
macros.doc: Add a small box with the weight of the question on the current line (right aligned).

macros.name: questionweight
macros.doc: Add a small box with the weight of the question on the current line (right aligned).

macros.name: room
macros.doc: \room specifies the rooms in which the exam will take place.

macros.name: setmcsymbol
macros.doc: sets the symbol to be used as multiple choice mark (by default a square).

macros.name: shorttitle
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@shorttitle tag that later will be used in the exam class.

macros.name: studentnr
macros.doc: \studentnr specifies the exam copy number.

macros.name: tend
macros.doc: This macro will set the \@tend tag that will be used on the exam title page.

macros.name: tstart
macros.doc: \tstart specifies the start time of the exam, preferrable in the format ’HHhMM’, e.g. ’08h30’.
